newsitem.title: USA: Torchmark Corp Q4 oper shr rises to $1.17.
newsitem.headline: Torchmark Corp Q4 oper shr rises to $1.17.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Above results reflect net operating income from continuing operations.
1995 Q4 oper result excludes a charge of $131.6 million or $1.84 a share from discontinued operations.
1996 year excludes a charge of $7.1 million, or $0.10 a share, from discontinued operations.
1995 year excludes a charge of $128.7 million, or $1.80 a share, from discontinued operations.
Q4 net income per share from continuing operations (including capital gains): $1.17 vs $1.05.
Q4 net income per share: profit $1.17 vs loss $0.79.
Year net income per share from continuing operations (including capital gains): $4.47 vs $3.80.
Year net income per share: $4.37 vs $2.00.
